description: MENTAL cap membership depends on resolved_at 'when valid', but neither artifact defines validity, null handling, chronological constraints, or treatment of a parseable timestamp outside the trigger period. Implementations can bucket the same delivery on different local days and select different first-three winners, so iteration-1 FIND-005 is not materially closed despite the added tie-breaker.

evidence.snippet: Delivery day/order use resolved_at when valid, otherwise occurred_at, then lexicographic public_ref as the exact tie-breaker.
